body: **Original comment by apostel338 (Bitbucket: [apostel338](https://bitbucket.org/apostel338), GitHub: [apostel338](https://github.com/apostel338)).** ---------------------------------------- German translation is WIP. I already took the matching strings from RT independently from this post. Still quite some ART-exclusive stuff to do. Also the RT texts need to be reviewed as there are many changes. Could it also be that there are some unused leftovers in the language files? :thinking: E.g. where’s the fast export tab? However, just a little patience. ‌ Edit \(just some remarks so far\) > FILEBROWSER\_ZOOMINHINT;Increase thumbnail size.\\n\\nShortcuts:\\n\+ - Multiple Editor Tabs Mode,\\nAlt-\+ - Single Editor Tab Mode. > FILEBROWSER\_ZOOMOUTHINT;Decrease thumbnail size.\\n\\nShortcuts:\\n- - Multiple Editor Tabs Mode,\\nAlt-- - Single Editor Tab Mode. Why differentiate between single- and multi-tab mode. In both modes simply **\+** and **-** work. ‌ > FILEBROWSER\_SHOWEXIFINFO;Show Exif info.\\n\\nShortcuts:\\ni - Multiple Editor Tabs Mode,\\nAlt-i - Single Editor Tab Mode. Same. Probably there are more of those. ‌ > FILEBROWSER\_COLORLABEL\_TOOLTIP;Color label.\\n\\nUse dropdown menu or shortcuts:\\nShift-Ctrl-0 No Color\\nShift-Ctrl-1 Red\\nShift-Ctrl-2 Yellow\\nShift-Ctrl-3 Green\\nShift-Ctrl-4 Blue\\nShift-Ctrl-5 Purple The _Shift-Ctrl-0 No Color_ doesn’t work.
